comparison.objective: Relocate a deck plate to match a setup sheet, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual discrepancy detection and rigid-object pick/place alignment, not tool insertion or response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Deck must match the setup sheet; pose tolerance, plate identity, collision, and seating criteria are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests procedure-driven layout correction, not mechanical calibration.
